fire: NumPy is an open source package that is used for numerical computing.
Redis is a fast data store that is used for caching.
The council serves its members, acting as the voice of the region.
The bureau acts as a bridge, acting as the contact between ministries.
SQLite stores tables in a file. SQLite works with most languages.
Nginx handles many connections. Nginx works as a reverse proxy.

quiet: NumPy is an open source package first released in 2006.
